# FormField

The label, hint and error that surround a control, and the wiring that associates them with it. It renders no control of its own.

## Anatomy

Label, then the control the caller renders, then the hint and the error beneath.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` *(required)* | `string` | — | — |
| `hint` | `string` | `''` | A note under the control, associated through `aria-describedby`. |
| `error` | `string` | `''` | Replaces the hint, marks the control invalid, and is announced when it appears. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `id` | `string` | ``sanctum-form-field-${crypto.randomUUID()}`` | — |
| `children` *(required)* | `Snippet<[FormFieldContext]>` | — | Receives the ids and invalid flag the control must apply to itself. |

## Variants

None.

## States

Default, required, invalid.

## Keyboard

Not interactive. The control it wraps carries the keyboard behaviour.

## ARIA

Passes the control an `id` and the `aria-describedby` value joining whichever of the hint and error are present, and tells it whether it is invalid. The error carries `role="alert"`, so it is announced when it appears rather than only when the field is next visited.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
- Every control it wraps must apply the `controlId`, `describedby` and `invalid` it is given; a control that ignores them is unlabelled.

## Reference correspondence

None. The reference has no field wrapper — each of its inputs re-implements its own label and note. This is the component that stops that recurring.
